author: WP02
summary: The unit is the command-line configuration chapter: prerequisites, submodules, the default Linux build, a CMake option table, the generated version header, Windows native and MinGW routes, Android and Emscripten, system SDL, FFmpeg and Draco, and how to verify a build. Much of it is stale at TARGET (a GCC 12 floor, --target CNA, CNA_TEST_DISPLAY ":0", project-wide sanitizer flags, mandatory FFmpeg, libswscale at run time). docs/building.html and the Development build pages already held the option facts; the residue (per-route toolchains, test execution and what a green result proves, the ccache launcher rule, the Windows DLL copy, Emscripten Node versus browser evidence) went into a new build-routes deep dive.

empty_sections.heading: Configuring and Building CNA
empty_sections.reason: chapter title only; the unit has no introductory prose before its first section

concepts.text: CNA requires CMake 3.20 or newer (cmake_minimum_required) and C++23 with compiler extensions off.

A Linux toolchain floor of GCC 12+ or Clang 15+ is not enforced: CMake checks no compiler version, the always-built content code needs <format>, and CI's workflows use GCC 14, AppleClang, MSVC, mingw-w64 GCC and emsdk 6.0.3.
tokens: No route checks the compiler version
concepts.note: Bible states GCC 12+/Clang 15+ as the minimum; TARGET has no check and CI proves only the listed compilers.

concepts.text: Sibling checkouts: ../sharp-runtime is always required; ../easy-gl is required only for the five EasyGL identities (OPENGLES2, OPENGLES3, OPENGL33, WEBGL1, WEBGL2), and easy-gl itself needs ../meta-gl; ../free-direct (with ../free-api) only for FREEDIRECT.
concepts.note: The Bible omits meta-gl and free-direct/free-api; the site lists all four.

concepts.text: SDL3, SDL3_image and SDL3_mixer are built from vendored Git submodules by default, so a first build needs no system SDL packages (development headers for the window system still matter).
tokens: no system SDL packages are required

concepts.text: The root version is project(CNA VERSION 0.1.0) plus the non-cache variable CNA_VERSION_PRERELEASE alpha.1, and every configure prints 'CNA: version 0.1.0-alpha.1'; the banner names the product version, so it cannot distinguish a tagged checkout from the development snapshot.
Windows builds are said to work with MSVC 2022 v17.8+, clang-cl or MinGW-w64; at TARGET only MSVC on windows-latest (manual workflows) and mingw-w64 GCC are exercised, and no workflow uses clang-cl.
concepts.note: Version floors and clang-cl support are unproven at TARGET.

concepts.text: A native Windows configure with the default SDL_RENDERER needs only the sharp-runtime sibling.
Before the first build the vendored SDL submodules must be populated with git submodule update --init.

A GitHub 'Download ZIP' archive contains no submodule content; the configure then stops with a specific message naming the missing directory (and, for googletest, saying a ZIP or tarball export cannot contain submodules) instead of failing later on a missing header.

The alternatives to cloning with submodules are cloning and initialising, or CNA_USE_SYSTEM_SDL=ON; the system-SDL route replaces only the SDL trees, so GoogleTest (while tests are on) and Draco (while enabled) must still come from somewhere.
concepts.note: Bible presents CNA_USE_SYSTEM_SDL as a full way around a ZIP archive; googletest and draco guards remain.

concepts.section: The default build: Linux, the OpenGL ES 3 renderer
concepts.text: The Bible's default build builds '--target CNA CnaTests'; CNA is an INTERFACE library with no sources and is not a buildable target, so a build must name real targets or build everything.
concepts.note: Command corrected on the site.

concepts.section: The default build: Linux, the OpenGL ES 3 renderer
concepts.text: OPENGLES3 is the Linux default renderer and is implemented by the shared EasyGL family.

concepts.section: The default build: Linux, the OpenGL ES 3 renderer
concepts.text: Swapping renderer is one -DCNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERER flag, but not every target exists for every identity: cna_house3d_demo exists only when the single default renderer is a GL-family identity, VULKAN, WEBGPU or FNA3D.
tokens: Exists only when the single default renderer
concepts.note: The Bible says the same targets exist regardless of identity.

concepts.section: The default build: Linux, the OpenGL ES 3 renderer
concepts.text: The 25 public identities fall into GL-shaped, modern and abstraction APIs, Direct3D/Windows 2D and 2D/web/CPU/diagnostic groups; FREEDIRECT belongs with the portable 2D renderers because it is not Windows-gated.
concepts.note: The Bible's table files FREEDIRECT under 'DirectX and Windows families'.

concepts.section: The default build: Linux, the OpenGL ES 3 renderer
concepts.text: Windows, browser, macOS, dependency and architecture gates are enforced during configuration, not at compile time.
tokens: hard-gated and refuse to configure off their platform

concepts.text: CNA_USE_CCACHE (ON) sets both compiler launchers to 'cmake -E env CCACHE_BASEDIR=<dir> ccache' before sharp-runtime is added; it replaces a launcher that is unset, empty, 'ccache' or the found ccache path and leaves any other launcher alone.
tokens: The compiler launcher is replaced, not added
concepts.note: The Bible says the launcher is wired in 'unless a launcher is already set'; a plain ccache launcher is replaced.

concepts.text: CNA_BUILD_TESTS (ON) builds the CnaTests binary and the 22 focused test targets and registers CTest entries; it needs the vendor/googletest submodule.
CNA_BUILD_EXAMPLES (ON) builds the examples admitted by the selected modules, renderer and host.
CNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERERS (empty) opts into a semicolon-separated renderer set; empty means single-renderer mode and CNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERER names the required default member.
tokens: The singular default must be a member

concepts.text: CNA_PLATFORM (SDL3) selects window, event, input, timing and host services among SDL3, SDL2, X11, WAYLAND, WIN32, HEADLESS and TERMINAL, with host gates.
tokens: SDL3, SDL2, X11, WAYLAND, WIN32, HEADLESS, TERMINAL

concepts.text: CNA_AUDIO_PLATFORM (SDL3) independently selects SDL3, SDL2, NULL or Linux-only ALSA; only SDL3 and ALSA define SOUND_ENABLED.
CNA_BUILD_C_API (OFF) adds the experimental C17 shared library CNA::CApi with ABI 0.29.0; whether the library builds at TARGET is not established because no workflow builds it.
concepts.note: The Bible says TARGET builds a versioned 0.29.0 ABI; kept hedged.

concepts.text: CNA_BUILD_INSPECTOR (OFF) builds the Inspector agent, bridge, browser assets and the cna-inspector executable.
CNA_DIAGNOSTICS selects OFF, STATS or FULL, which controls the compiled instrumentation level.
CNA_CNAEXT (OFF) gates the CNA::Graphics engine layer and is unrelated to the CNAEXT declaration marker.
CNA_DEVICES (OFF) enables the CNA-specific device and sensor extensions beyond XNA 4.0; the XNA-shaped sensors are always built.
tokens: the XNA-shaped sensors are always built

concepts.text: CNA_ENABLE_NET (ON) builds Net and GamerServices and pulls in the vendored ENet.
CNA_SHARP_RUNTIME_ROOT overrides the sharp-runtime tree; a release may record a verified sibling revision but CMake never checks which commit it received.
tokens: No part of CNA checks which sharp-runtime commit it got

concepts.text: CNA_USE_SYSTEM_SDL (OFF) uses find_package for system SDL3 packages instead of the vendored submodules.
tokens: Link against system SDL3 packages instead of the vendored submodules

concepts.text: The Bible gives CNA_TEST_DISPLAY a default of ':0' baked into every GPU test; at TARGET the default is empty (tests inherit the caller's DISPLAY) and ':0' is honoured only with CNA_TEST_ALLOW_LIVE_DISPLAY=ON.
concepts.note: Default corrected to empty on the site.

concepts.text: CNA_SANITIZE is described as flags added project-wide; at TARGET the instrumentation is attached to CNA-owned targets, sharp-runtime and the test executables, not to the vendored SDL or ENet sub-builds.
tokens: not the vendored SDL or ENet
concepts.note: Scope corrected on the site.

concepts.text: Some combinations are refused by name at configure time: TERMINAL admits only CPU or diagnostic renderers, SDL2-only mode has its own consistency gate, renderers add SDK and architecture constraints, and CNA_BUILD_C_API without CNA_ENABLE_NET is a FATAL_ERROR.
The design principle: an invalid build combination becomes an explicit configure-time contract that names the option instead of failing during compilation or silently substituting another value.
tokens: Never fall back to another identity

concepts.text: Configuration generates CNA/Version.hpp in the build include tree, exposing CNA_VERSION_MAJOR/_MINOR/_PATCH/_PRERELEASE/_STRING and constexpr accessors such as getVersionString() and isPreReleaseVersion().
The Git tag has a leading 'v' (v0.1.0-alpha.1) but the product string reported by CMake and C++ does not.
tokens: The leading v belongs to the Git tag

concepts.text: The example that prints getVersionString() was compile-checked and run by the Bible's authors against a HEADLESS/HEADLESS/NULL configuration of an earlier revision; that is an observation of the header at that revision, not a renderer test or a release claim.
concepts.note: Evidence record from an earlier revision's documentation campaign; the header template is unchanged and its API is documented on docs/releases.html.

concepts.text: The C API's ABI version (0.29.0) is independent of the product version and of the XNA API level.

CNA_CNAEXT (a CMake option) and CNAEXT (a declaration marker present in every build) are independent; the option gates the whole CNA::Graphics engine layer in graphics-ext, whose guarded headers declare nothing in a default build, and CNA::CnaExt is a separate link umbrella.
RenderPipelineSettings is only a settings bag, not a description of the whole extension module.
On Windows the default renderer is SDL_RENDERER and SDL is built from the vendored submodules at configure time, with no pre-built binaries and no CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH setup.
tokens: no pre-built SDL and no CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH

concepts.text: After the vendored SDL install on Windows, every DLL of the install's bin directory is copied to the build root at configure time, because Windows has no RPATH and an executable without its DLL fails before main() with 0xC0000135.
concepts.note: TARGET extension.

concepts.text: MSVC needs /utf-8, /bigobj (COFF section limit in the serializer TU) and NOMINMAX, applied through the private cna_project_options target; the MinGW builds never showed the min/max problem because mingw-w64's libstdc++ defines NOMINMAX.
concepts.note: TARGET extension.

concepts.text: The MinGW-w64 cross-build uses cmake/toolchains/mingw-w64.cmake, which prefers the x86_64 compiler and silently falls back to i686 while CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR stays x86_64; its header comment about pre-built SDL on CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH is stale.
concepts.note: The toolchain detail and stale comment are TARGET findings.

concepts.text: In a MinGW cross tree CTest runs CnaTests through a Wine wrapper only when the default renderer is DIRECTX9, DIRECTX11, DIRECTX12 or DIRECT2D is compiled in (CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR set before discovery, with the DXVK/vkd3d presence gate skipped); other renderers get no emulator.
concepts.note: The Bible says every Windows-targeting CTest binary, SDL_RENDERER included, is verified through the MinGW toolchain.

concepts.text: Windows-only renderers are run under Wine with DXVK (Direct3D 9/11) or vkd3d-proton (Direct3D 12); that is evidence for the translation stack, while CI's automatic win32-cross job runs only the Win32 platform harness and full-engine Windows builds are manual MSVC workflows.
concepts.note: Evidence ceiling added.

concepts.section: Building for Android and the Web
concepts.text: Android and the web have no CNA toolchain file; they use the NDK's and Emscripten's toolchains. The tree holds exactly two toolchain files, mingw-w64.cmake and ios.cmake, and the web preset names none, so it must be run through emcmake.
concepts.note: The Bible omits ios.cmake.

concepts.text: The Android cross-compile shape uses the NDK toolchain file, arm64-v8a and android-24; the Bible's command ends with '--target CNA', which cannot work because CNA is an INTERFACE target.

The NDK version in any Android command (30.0.14904198 in the demo) is whatever is installed locally, not a requirement; no preset, workflow or API-level check exists, and the packaged Devices demo adds CNA as a subdirectory with tests and examples forced off, reusing CNA's .sdl-prebuilt-Android-aarch64 install.
tokens: The NDK path in any command is whatever is installed locally

concepts.text: The claim that CNA_BUILD_TESTS=OFF is mandatory on Android because GoogleTest was never configured for the NDK is not stated by the CMake: nothing refuses tests for Android, only the module probes are excluded there, and whether a test build links was not established.

target.evidence: cmake/UnitTests.cmake (no Android refusal); cmake/Tests/ModuleProbes.cmake (NOT ANDROID guard)

concepts.text: A successful Android configure and compile is compile-only evidence: no APK packaging, emulator or device run is involved.
tokens: says nothing about packaging, an emulator or a device

target.evidence: CMake has no Android packaging or run step

concepts.text: Using the NDK's own llvm-nm rather than the host nm to confirm that platform-conditional code was compiled in.
concepts.note: Tooling advice from an earlier Android verification campaign; no CNA script, test or document at TARGET relies on it and it was not re-verified.

concepts.text: CANVAS and the other browser renderers are Emscripten-only and are refused at configure time on native targets, the same way Direct3D renderers are refused off Windows.
tokens: All five need browser APIs and are Emscripten-only

concepts.text: Under Emscripten CnaTests is built too, linked with -sEXIT_RUNTIME=1 (otherwise Node never exits after main) and -sJSPI=1 (so loopback networking tests can yield to Node's event loop), and is run as node --experimental-wasm-stack-switching CnaTests.js.
concepts.note: The Bible's plain 'node build-web/CnaTests.js' predates the JSPI requirement.

concepts.text: The Bible recorded an emcc 6.0.2 configure and build whose CnaTests.js linked and passed a 35-case renderer-agnostic Rectangle suite under Node.
concepts.note: Recorded run at an earlier revision and emsdk; CI now pins emsdk 6.0.3 and no current record repeats it. The page says earlier Node passes are history for their own revision.

concepts.text: That web build surfaced a sibling defect: sharp-runtime's FileSystemWatcher.hpp declared inotify fields outside the __linux__ guard, reported fixed in sharp-runtime.
concepts.note: A defect of the sibling repository at an earlier revision, reported fixed there; not a CNA fact at TARGET. Recorded as a not-an-issue candidate (WP02-i011).

concepts.text: Node-based verification and real-browser verification are different claims: Node has no DOM, CanvasRenderingContext2D or WebGL, so browser renderers are exercised separately (htmldom-ci in Chromium through Playwright; script-driven runs for others), and the multi-renderer web job only builds and links.
tokens: Node and the browser are different claims
it runs nothing in a browser

concepts.section: System-installed SDL, if you prefer it
concepts.text: With CNA_USE_SYSTEM_SDL=ON the configure calls find_package(SDL3 REQUIRED), find_package(SDL3_image REQUIRED) and find_package(SDL3_mixer REQUIRED), so the three development packages must be installed.
FFmpeg is described as required for VideoPlayer; at TARGET it is optional (CNA_ENABLE_VIDEO=AUTO), and without it the video types link and throw NotSupportedException.
tokens: FFmpeg is no longer a hard requirement
concepts.note: Optional at TARGET.

concepts.text: libswscale is neither included nor linked: CNA's FFmpeg backend links libavcodec, libavformat, libavutil and libswresample and converts YUV to RGBA itself; the Bible's claim that the runtime libswscale library must be present is not supported by CNA's build.
tokens: libswscale is neither included nor linked

concepts.text: Draco decoding is on by default through the third_party/draco gitlink at Draco 1.5.7 so conformance does not depend on the host's Draco; CNA_USE_SYSTEM_DRACO=ON selects a system package and CNA_ENABLE_DRACO=OFF builds the refusal path. At TARGET the default is OFF under Emscripten.
tokens: does not depend on which distribution version
concepts.note: Emscripten default added.

concepts.text: CNA ships no bundled playable demo as its primary proof of a working build; a ladder of steps stands in for it.

target.evidence: repository layout (no top-level game demo target)

concepts.text: ctest and cna_demo_2d are the Bible's stand-ins; at TARGET an unfiltered ctest after building only CnaTests reports every unbuilt standalone program as failed, cna_demo_2d --smoke N runs N frames and exits, and running the CnaTests binary directly is the preset's recommended runner.
tokens: An unfiltered ctest after building only CnaTests
concepts.note: The Bible says ctest runs the CnaTests suite plus GPU tests.

concepts.text: cna_demo_2d is the shared 2D integration program and works with every renderer.

All 20 workflow files are manually dispatchable and 18 also have a push trigger (17 on next/develop/main plus pull requests, content-pipeline-windows-ci on its own branch); the Direct3D and GDI workflows are manual only.
tokens: all 20 workflow files can be dispatched by hand and 18 also have a push trigger

concepts.text: A green badge is evidence for the routes that workflow engages, not a project-wide test count or proof that every renderer ran.
tokens: A green badge is evidence for the route that workflow engages
